name: Brihat Gangadhara Churna

sections.introduction: Brihat Gangadhara Churna is an ayurvrdic formulation that is prepared from various herbs mixture. This formulation is known for its alternative and astringent properties. This treats gastrointestinal and dysentery problems.
sections.ingredients:
Musta ( Cyperus rotundus ) 
 Bilva ( Aegle marmelos ) 
 Dhataki ( Woodfordia fruticosa ) 
 Kutaja ( Holarrhena antidysenterica’s bark ) 
 Araluka ( Ailanthus excels ) 
 Lajjalu ( Mimosa pudica ) 
 Ginger ( Zingiber officinalis ) 
 Patha ( Cyclea peltata ) 
 Balaka ( Pavonia odorata ) 
 Amrabeeja ( Mangifera indica’s seeds ) 
 Prativisha ( Aconitum heterophyllum ) 
 Lodhra ( Symplocos racemosa ) 
 Mocharasa ( Bombax ceiba ) 
 Indrayava ( Holarrhena antidysenterica’s seeds ) 

 Method of preparation 

 Took all the herbs up to 10 gram. 
 Powdered all the herbs separately. 
 Now collect all the powdered herbs and mix together to form Brihat Gangadhara Churna.
sections.dose:
2 to 6 grams, three times a day before or after meals. 
 Inidications 

 Indigestion 
 Diarrhea 
 Sprue syndrome 
 Irregular bowel movements 
 Dysentery
sections.contraindications:
Over dose can cause constipation. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Brihat Gangadhara Churna 
 Reference – Sharangadhara, Madhyama Khanda 6/49 – 51. 
 Introduction 
 Brihat Gangadhara Churna is an ayurvrdic formulation that is prepared from various herbs mixture. This formulation is known for its alternative and astringent properties. This treats gastrointestinal and dysentery problems. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Musta ( Cyperus rotundus ) 
 Bilva ( Aegle marmelos ) 
 Dhataki ( Woodfordia fruticosa ) 
 Kutaja ( Holarrhena antidysenterica’s bark ) 
 Araluka ( Ailanthus excels ) 
 Lajjalu ( Mimosa pudica ) 
 Ginger ( Zingiber officinalis ) 
 Patha ( Cyclea peltata ) 
 Balaka ( Pavonia odorata ) 
 Amrabeeja ( Mangifera indica’s seeds ) 
 Prativisha ( Aconitum heterophyllum ) 
 Lodhra ( Symplocos racemosa ) 
 Mocharasa ( Bombax ceiba ) 
 Indrayava ( Holarrhena antidysenterica’s seeds ) 
 
 Method of preparation 
 
 Took all the herbs up to 10 gram. 
 Powdered all the herbs separately. 
 Now collect all the powdered herbs and mix together to form Brihat Gangadhara Churna. 
 
 Dose 
 2 to 6 grams, three times a day before or after meals. 
 Inidications 
 
 Indigestion 
 Diarrhea 
 Sprue syndrome 
 Irregular bowel movements 
 Dysentery 
 
 Contraindications 
 Over dose can cause constipation. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
